msg: Hi! We're staying in Cartagena's old town, so we'd leave from Cartagena. I'm Open Water certified, my last dive was 8 months ago. How much are two dives and what's included?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Perfect, two dives from Cartagena is a great plan — you'll love the reefs around the Rosario Islands! 🌊

Since your last dive was 8 months ago, you're well within the range for a normal fun dive (a refresher is only needed after more than 2 years without diving), so you're good to go.

**What's included in the 2-dive day trip from Cartagena:**
- National Park entrance fee
- Mandatory dive insurance
- Speedboat transport Cartagena–Islands–Cartagena
- 2 guided dives with a certified PADI professional
- Diving equipment
- Lunch
- Eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL

**Not included:**
- Ground transport to the dock
- Underwater photos or videos
- Tips
- Extra food beyond the included lunch
- Return on a different date

**How the day goes:**
- Meet at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m. (5 min from the historic center)
- Speedboat to the Rosario Islands (about 1 hour)
- Welcome at our island dive base and gear setup
- 2 reef dives with a surface interval
- Lunch at the hotel facilities
- Return to Cartagena around 3:00 p.m. (arriving approx. 4:15 p.m.)

One note: departing from Cartagena there's no hotel pick-up — everyone gets to the dock on their own.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD (630.000 COP · 700.000 COP)
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD (1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD (1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP)

I'm leaving the price per person below. Would you like me to help you set up the booking?

msg: Great, thanks. I'm Canadian and it's just me. Could you send me the booking link for Thursday?
reply:
Perfect! Since you're Canadian, you'll pay in US dollars — it's the same price, only the currency changes. 💵

Here's the booking link for the 2-dive day trip from Cartagena:

https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

There you pick your date (Thursday works) and pay by card — the 10% online discount is applied automatically. Just a heads-up: the system closes at 4:30 PM the day before, so if you're booking for Thursday, keep that in mind. And on the day, remember to bring your certified diver card (or send us a photo beforehand). 🤿

🤿 *Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day)*
💰 *178 USD* per person (online rate)
✅ Includes: National Park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, speedboat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena, 2 guided dives with a certified PADI professional, diving equipment, lunch and eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL.
📍 Departure from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita, 8:00 a.m.).

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿
